_note: Curated, real, publicly-sourced opportunities across Southern Europe and the Nordics. Each item carries a real source_url. Refresh via `python -m sai_agents.deals.generate`. Sourced 2026-07.

deals.title: 2025 Call for Science and Innovation Missions (Responsible AI mission-challenge)
deals.org: CDTI (Centro para el Desarrollo Tecnológico y la Innovación)
deals.description: CDTI's 2025 Missions call, endowed with EUR 60M, funds collaborative R&D including a mission-challenge on Responsible Artificial Intelligence, with projects running 3-4 years from January 2026.

deals.title: Multiverse Computing raises USD 215M Series B (CompactifAI LLM-compression)
deals.description: Spanish quantum-inspired AI firm Multiverse Computing raised EUR 189M (USD 215M) in a Series B led by Bullhound Capital to scale its CompactifAI technology that compresses LLMs by up to 95%.

deals.title: Tucuvi raises EUR 17M Series A to scale clinical voice AI (LOLA)
deals.description: Madrid healthtech Tucuvi raised EUR 17M (USD 20M) Series A led by Cathay Innovation and Kfund/Leadwind to scale its clinically-certified voice AI agent for automated patient follow-up.

deals.title: Lanzadera high-performance accelerator cohort (120 startups, AI focus)
deals.description: Valencia-based accelerator Lanzadera admitted a new cohort of 120 startups, with AI increasingly central; offers mentoring, corporate access and zero-equity loans.

deals.title: Tender: management services for the AI startup acceleration programme at BSC
deals.description: BSC-CNS procured comprehensive management services for its AI-focused startup acceleration programme; the contract was formalised on 22 June 2026.

deals.title: Tender: data office & AI governance model consultancy 2026-2027
deals.description: Provincial government of Bizkaia tendered consultancy and technical assistance for its data office and AI governance model for 2026-2027.

deals.title: PRR call 'IA nas PME' - AI adoption grants for SMEs
deals.description: Portugal's Recovery and Resilience Plan made EUR 100M available for SMEs to adopt AI, as a non-repayable subsidy covering 75% of investment up to EUR 300,000 per company; Phase II closed 28 November 2025.

deals.title: Portugal to invest up to EUR 200M in an AI Gigafactory (EuroHPC)
deals.description: Portugal approved investment of up to EUR 200M to install and operate an AI Gigafactory under the European EuroHPC programme, with matching EU funding, to boost technological sovereignty.

deals.title: START Rise Challenge - AI startups programme
deals.description: Porto Business School runs the START Rise Challenge, a programme focused on AI startups in Portugal.

deals.title: IPCEI Artificial Intelligence - Italian participation call
deals.org: MIMIT (Ministry of Enterprise and Made in Italy)
deals.description: MIMIT launched the IPCEI AI (Important Project of Common European Interest) to build a sovereign European AI ecosystem across the value chain; application deadline was 30 January 2026.

deals.title: CDP Venture Capital and OpenAI partnership for AI development in Italy
deals.description: Italian state-backed CDP Venture Capital and OpenAI announced an alliance to support AI development in Italy, complementing CDP's EUR 500M Fondo Artificial Intelligence for AI, cybersecurity and quantum startups.

deals.title: Contents secures EUR 5.9M for AI workflow/agent orchestration platform
deals.description: Milan-based Contents, a platform for orchestrating AI agents, enterprise knowledge and approval workflows, raised a EUR 5.9M Series B extension (total funding around EUR 21M) and opened a Doha hub.

deals.title: Lexroom raises EUR 42.9M Series B for AI legaltech
deals.description: Italian AI legaltech startup Lexroom raised a EUR 42.9M Series B just eight months after its EUR 16.2M Series A, signalling strong demand for AI in the legal sector.

deals.title: Pallma AI closes EUR 1.36M pre-seed for AI-agent security
deals.description: Greek-founded Pallma AI raised EUR 1.36M pre-seed led by Marathon Venture Capital to build a security layer for autonomous/agentic AI systems, expanding teams in Athens and London.

deals.title: Action 'Research - Innovate 2021-2027' calls (RTDI incl. AI)
deals.org: General Secretariat for Research and Innovation (GSRI)
deals.description: GSRI's 'Research - Innovate' action under the NSRF 2021-2027 Competitiveness Programme funds RTDI projects, including AI/data, co-funded by the Recovery and Resilience Fund.

deals.title: Pharos AI Factory - national AI hub launch
deals.description: Greece launched the Pharos AI Factory in 2025 as a national hub connecting startups, SMEs, research institutions, universities and the public sector across the AI development lifecycle.

deals.title: Shared, sustainable and secure AI infrastructure
deals.description: Vinnova call funding projects that build cost-effective and sustainable AI infrastructure for Swedish industry, offering SEK 2-15M per project (max 50% of eligible costs).

deals.title: Industrial Applied AI by Advanced Digitalization 2026
deals.description: Vinnova call under its Advanced Digitalization program funding applied AI projects in Swedish industry, offering SEK 2-10M per project at up to 50% of eligible costs.

deals.title: Funding call for high-growth companies to leverage cutting-edge AI (2026)
deals.description: Business Finland call for strongly growth-oriented companies (min EUR 2M revenue, 10+ staff, 20%+ growth) to launch forward-looking AI projects; open 2 February to 15 April 2026.

deals.title: Innovation Cluster Funding Call - AI technologies
deals.description: Business Finland call to fund one AI-technologies innovation cluster with up to EUR 500,000 (max 50% of eligible costs).

deals.title: Grand Solutions: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
deals.description: Innovation Fund Denmark's Grand Solutions programme with about DKK 80M earmarked for AI along the value chain, investing DKK 5-40M per project; phase 1 letter-of-interest deadline 3 March 2026.

deals.title: Research Centres for Artificial Intelligence (AI Centres)
deals.description: Research Council of Norway call establishing six national AI research centres starting in 2025, part of a plan to raise AI/digital research funding by at least NOK 1 billion over five years.

deals.title: Technology Development Fund (Tækniþróunarsjóður)
deals.description: Rannís-administered competitive fund supporting R&D and innovation in Icelandic industry, with software and AI among well-suited areas; issues calls twice a year.

deals.title: AI Sweden Startup Program
deals.description: AI Sweden's national program supporting AI startups with training, testing environments and goal-driven projects to accelerate their development and adoption of AI.

deals.title: Growth and Scaling Through AI (GSAI) accelerator
deals.description: Cross-border AI accelerator run by Movexum (SE), AI Sweden, Yrityssalo (FI) and Tehnopol (EE) supporting 45 companies over three years; a second 2026 cohort is planned.

deals.title: New Nordics AI initiative
deals.description: Cross-Nordic initiative launched in 2025 bringing together AI organisations from Sweden, Finland, Denmark, Norway and Iceland to accelerate regional AI development.

deals.title: Lovable raises USD 200M Series A at USD 1.8B valuation
deals.description: Swedish AI 'vibe coding' startup Lovable closed a USD 200M Series A led by Accel at a USD 1.8B valuation, backers incl. 20VC, ByFounders, Creandum, Hummingbird and Visionaries Club.

deals.title: Tana raises EUR 13.6M Series A for AI-native workspace
deals.description: Oslo-based AI-native workspace startup Tana raised a USD 14M (EUR 13.6M) Series A led by Tola Capital with Lightspeed, Northzone, Alliance VC and firstminute.

deals.title: Verda raises EUR 100M for renewable AI cloud infrastructure
deals.description: Helsinki-based GPU cloud provider Verda raised EUR 100M (equity led by Lifeline Ventures with byFounders, Tesi and Varma, plus Nordic debt) to expand its renewable-powered AI cloud and hire 100+ staff.

deals.title: GetWhy extends Series A with EUR 17M for AI research platform
deals.description: Copenhagen-based GetWhy raised an additional EUR 17M extending its Series A, led by PeakSpan Capital, for its AI qualitative-research platform used by brands such as Heineken, Nestlé and eBay.

deals.title: Denmark public big-data / AI tenders (udbud.dk)
deals.description: Aggregated listing of active Danish government big-data and analytics tenders and RFPs; Denmark publishes procurement via portals such as udbud.dk under EU rules.

deals.title: Sweden public-sector AI / digital transformation tenders
deals.org: Swedish public agencies, regions and municipalities
deals.description: Analysis mapping 250+ Swedish public-sector AI procurements (2016-2025, ~SEK 1.3B), forecasting cumulative AI procurement to double by 2028; tenders published via TendSign and e-Avrop.

deals.title: EIC Accelerator Open 2026
deals.description: The 2026 EIC Accelerator Open call has an indicative budget of EUR 414M and funds single deep-tech SMEs (incl. AI) with up to EUR 2.5M grants + up to EUR 15M equity; 2026 cut-offs 11 Feb, 6 May, 9 Sep, 25 Nov. Open to all EU + associated countries.

deals.title: Digital Europe Programme call DIGITAL-2026-AI-09 (Generative AI / AI Continent)
deals.description: Digital Europe Programme 2026 AI calls opened 21 April 2026 (deadline 1 October 2026), covering AI, generative AI and the AI Continent action plan; grants support real AI deployment in public services and industry.

deals.title: EuroHPC JU Call for Cooperation of AI Factories (COAIF-03)
deals.org: European High Performance Computing Joint Undertaking
deals.description: EuroHPC JU call (HORIZON-JU-EUROHPC-2026-COAIF-03), EUR 25M budget, to enhance cooperation between Europe's AI Factories and Antennas; 3-year projects, up to EUR 12.5M EU contribution.

deals.title: Horizon Europe Cluster 4 call HORIZON-CL4-2026-04 (Data & Trustworthy AI)
deals.description: Horizon Europe Cluster 4 Digital call, EUR 221.8M across 15 topics on secure single market and infrastructure for data services and trustworthy AI. Deadline 15 April 2026.

deals.title: EIC Pre-Accelerator 2026-2027 (WIDERA)
deals.description: EIC Pre-Accelerator supports early-stage deep-tech startups from Horizon Europe widening countries (incl. Greece, Portugal, Croatia, Slovenia, Cyprus, Malta); 2026-2027 WIDERA budget EUR 40M, first cohort of 70 selected April 2026.

deals.title: Women TechEU 2026-2028
deals.description: Women TechEU provides equity-free grants and acceleration to women-led deep-tech startups across the EU; 2026-2028 edition invests EUR 12M to support 160 companies via a continuous open call.

deals.title: SplxAI raises USD 7M seed round
deals.description: Croatian-founded SplxAI (AI/LLM application security) raised ~USD 7M (EUR 6.5M) seed led by LAUNCHub Ventures with Rain Capital, Inovo, Runtime, DNV and South Central Ventures; later acquired by Zscaler.

deals.title: Codeplain raises EUR 2.6M seed round
deals.description: Slovenian AI startup Codeplain (generates/tests/updates production software from plain-language specs) closed a EUR 2.6M (USD 3M) seed led by GapMinder with Silicon Gardens; operates from Ljubljana, Berlin, San Francisco.

deals.title: Sunrise Robotics emerges from stealth with USD 8.5M seed
deals.description: Ljubljana-based Sunrise Robotics emerged from stealth (June 2025) with USD 8.5M (EUR 7.3M) seed to build modular, simulation-trained industrial robotic cells; round led by Plural with Tapestry, Seedcamp, Tiny.vc, Prototype Capital.

deals.title: Legora raises USD 550M Series D at USD 5.55B valuation
deals.description: Stockholm-based legal AI startup Legora raised ~USD 550M (EUR 505M) Series D led by Accel (March 2026) at a USD 5.55B valuation; backers incl. Benchmark, Bessemer, General Catalyst, Iconiq, Redpoint, YC, Bain, Menlo, Salesforce Ventures.

deals.title: Cernel raises EUR 4M seed round
deals.description: Aarhus-based Danish startup Cernel (AI-driven e-commerce data platform / infrastructure for agentic commerce) raised a EUR 4M seed led by Seed Capital (February 2026).

deals.title: Cyprus RIF PRE-SEED startup development call 2026
deals.description: Cyprus' Research and Innovation Foundation opened a EUR 1M PRE-SEED call ('Creation and Initial Development of Startups with International Orientation'), up to EUR 119,999 per project; proposals due 11 September 2026.

deals.title: Malta Digitalise Your SME scheme - Call 2 (AI top-up)
deals.org: Malta Enterprise / Malta Digital Innovation Authority
deals.description: Malta's Digitalise Your SME Call 2 (May 2026) tripled the budget to EUR 15M; AI projects qualify for an extra EUR 107,000 on top of the base EUR 128,400 grant (up to EUR 235,400). Call 2 opens 1 July 2026, first cut-off 31 July 2026.

deals.title: NORAI: Balearic Islands AI-in-administration tender
deals.description: The Balearic regional government launched the NORAI tender (EUR 5.45M) to introduce AI across all departments of the regional administration; 24-month execution, tendered July 2026.

deals.title: Consip national framework agreement for AI to public administration
deals.description: Italy's central purchasing body Consip plans (Q3 2026) the first national framework agreement dedicated to supplying AI solutions to all public administrations, plus AI-assisted procurement to cut tender times.

deals.title: MENAC tender for AI module for the RGPC anti-corruption platform
deals.description: Portugal's National Anti-Corruption Mechanism (MENAC) launched a public tender to acquire an AI module for its RGPC platform, part of a broader public-administration AI adoption push.
